frequency_question: How often is a successor treaty signed prior to expiration across comparable historical instances?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral transboundary water treaties reaching a sunset clause or renewal date; excludes internal state water pacts and non-binding declarations.
window: Within the final 36 months leading up to treaty expiration.

cases.name: Columbia River Treaty renegotiation milestones (historical renewals/protocols)
Lesotho Highlands Water Project phase agreements
Senegal River Basin Development Organization protocol renewals
India-Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty permanent commission continuous operations (not expiring, excluded)

coverage_note: 6 named cases; believed roughly 8 major comparable instances globally in recent decades.
known_gaps: Comprehensive global tracking of minor bilateral river basin accords is unevenly documented.
skeleton: 6 historical transboundary water treaty renewal cycles examined, yielding 5 successful prior renewals/successors within the window.
validity_reason: International water diplomacy norms and bureaucratic continuity remain stable over multi-year horizons.
